title: While

lines.explanation:
while statement allows you to execute a piece of code several times, while a certain condition is true. In this case we execute a block of statements while 'count' is less than 11
while-loop is a loop with pre-condition, which means it checks for the condition before going into the loop
on every step of the loop we print the current value of 'count'...

and then we increment the value of 'count' by 1.Hence, this loop  will execute 10 times and it will print 1,2,3....9,10.On the last step after it prints 10, and increase 'count' to 11 the 'while'-condition becomes false, since 'count' is not lees then 11 any more. And the loop stops.
